description: Sets how Sergio speaks to customers, as the reply-tone setting does: preset friendly or professional, or custom with a customPrompt (up to 500 characters) instruction. Reversible. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: set_ai_tone
title: Set Sergio's reply tone
